title: Repeated Substring Pattern
description: Check if a string can be constructed by taking a substring of it and appending multiple copies of the substring together.
pseudocode:
1. let s = 'abab'
2. let str = (s + s).slice(1, -1)
3. return str.includes(s)

steps.note: Concatenate s + s = 'abababab', then slice first and last chars
Check if 'bababa' includes 'abab'. It does not contain 'abab' fully. Actually, wait: 'bababa' contains 'abab' at index 1.
